label: Transition — Village into Victorian
candidates: The wanderers have built clocktowers. The chimneys are smoking now.
Top hats and canes. The settlements have grown factories, and time has written itself in brick.
The coifs are gone — everyone is wearing top hats now, and the villages have become towns with smoking stacks.
Clocktowers stand where the villages were. The people wear top hats and carry canes, and the factories are already smoking.
The second age: factories rise where settlements stood, their smoke climbing into the grey. Everyone who built them is wearing a top hat.
The settlements have aged into towns. Clocktowers mark the hours now, and smoke rises from every roof.
Top hats and factory smoke. The villages have become industrial, and the people dress like they remember when they weren't.
The world has built its second skin: clocktowers, smoking chimneys, top hats on everyone who used to wear a coif.
